paragraphs: The Siri Modular watch face is picking up two new styles in the upcoming watchOS 27.3 update. Both of them are built around a new three-button Siri module.
That brings the number of styles to five for the only new face Apple added in watchOS 27.
The update is still in beta, with a full release expected sometime in December.

The Siri Modular watch face came to Apple Watch in watchOS 27. Its distinctive Siri module adds shortcuts for interacting with the voice assistant, including starting conversations and accessing AI-powered features. Users can choose from several layouts that balance the size of the clock with the number and arrangement of shortcuts.
The original version mixes large and compact digital clocks with circular complications and a Smart Stack tile (see picture above).

The two new styles coming in watchOS 27.3 include a pill-shaped module with three icon shortcuts. One jumps to Siri conversations, the other invokes Siri AI and the third one opens Siri Recaps in the app.

One style pairs the module with a large digital clock. The other one has a compact digital clock plus a Smart Stack tile. Also, the three-circular complications layout can take an icon that invokes Siri AI.
The shortcuts tie into new Audio Intelligence features that Apple Watch Series 12 and the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will get when watchOS 27.3 launches.
